MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure Agreement is made on 3 August 2026 between Kite Robotics Private Limited and Orbit Labs LLP (each a "Party").

1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
"Confidential Information" means any business, technical or financial information disclosed by one Party to the other and marked as confidential.

2. EXCLUSIONS
Confidential Information does not include information that is publicly available or was already known to the receiving Party.

3. OBLIGATIONS
The receiving Party shall use Confidential Information only to evaluate a possible business partnership and shall not disclose it to any third party.

4. DURATION
The obligations under this agreement continue for three (3) years from the date of this agreement.

5. RETURN OF INFORMATION
On request, the receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information.
